stories.title: Michigan State Police seek driver in hit-and-run
stories.summary: Michigan State Police are seeking the driver who was involved in a hit-and-run crash on November 10 in Jackson. A 5-year-old girl was injured as a result of the collision.

stories.title: Gamers celebrate Grand Theft Auto video game release; Eastbound I-696 close to opening; other storie
stories.summary: Video game fans celebrate the newest release of Grand Theft Auto. Eastbound I-696 in Oakland County is close to reopening. Those headlines and other top stories are in the CBS Detroit news brief.

stories.title: 4 children, 2 adults, pets receiving medical care after Shelby Township house fire
stories.summary: Six people and the family pets are all receiving medical care after a house fire early Thursday in Macomb County.

stories.title: President Trump meets with Russian and Chinese leaders
stories.summary: President Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin sat down for a meeting in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. CBS News has this report.

stories.title: 6-year-old dead, 3 others injured, in aftermath of house fire in Detroit
stories.summary: A six-year-old boy has died, with three others injured, in the aftermath of a house fire early Thursday in Detroit.

stories.title: Detroit Fire and Rescue officials relate scene of fatal fire
stories.summary: The 6-year-old who was found dead amid a house fire during the early morning of Nov. 19 "did not have a chance," Detroit first responders said.

stories.title: More sun and warmer temps
stories.summary: Happy Thursday, Family! Another cool start this morning, then sunny and mild with a high of 61°. We stay dry heading into the weekend with temps warming and staying above normal until Sunday when a cold front arrives with our next chance for rain. Cooler next week.

stories.title: 1 dead, 3 hurt in Detroit house fire
stories.summary: A 6-year-old child has died, and three others injured, in the aftermath of a house fire on Lawrence Street in Detroit.

stories.title: John Collins scores 20 points as Pistons win 122-109 over Pelicans
stories.summary: John Collins hit four 3-pointers and scored 20 points to lead seven Detroit players in double figures as the Pistons beat the New Orleans Pelicans 122-109.

stories.title: GTA VI release brings excitement for Michigan gamers, potential impact on workplaces
stories.summary: After more than a decade of anticipation, the wait for Grand Theft Auto VI is over. But the highly anticipated release could mean more than just a big night for gamers.

stories.title: Warming up and cooling down
stories.summary: Temperatures continue to climb through Saturday before plummeting next week.
